protocol.primary_observation: Rate of cells incorrect at 8 and corrected at 9 that become incorrect again at any native level 10..12, paired by puzzle; strict locking is refuted by a native counterexample.
protocol.secondary_acceleration: Test-puzzle mean of net correctness gain 8->9 minus mean net gains 7->8 and 9->10; paired puzzle bootstrap.
protocol.curve_fits: Descriptive continuous piecewise-linear least-squares fits on 12 points; internal knots 3..10, separately against step and cumulative generated-code count. Bootstrap knot preferences, not phase-transition significance.
protocol.scope: Exploratory second direction; all existing datasets already inspected in previous campaigns. No proof of thermodynamic phase transition from finite fixed-depth checkpoints.
